planNote: A planned visit becomes confirmed only after a qualified, available caregiver is assigned and the server accepts the assignment.

completeNote: Completed visit notes are retained. A later correction must be a separate, audited addendum.

requestNote: Review and commercial acceptance do not automatically create a patient or confirm an appointment.
